item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows a beam of light meeting Niyati's plane mirror. A polished steel plate is also available.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: The mirror changes the direction of the beam by reflection.
options.B: The beam bends toward the wall even though it passes beside the mirror.
options.C: A polished steel plate cannot reflect light; only glass mirrors can.
options.D: No reflection occurs because there is no bright spot on another surface.
